pipelines.name: Objects (80 everyday classes)
pipelines.description: People, vehicles, animals, furniture, food, electronics… (YOLO11s, COCO).

pipelines.name: Find by text
pipelines.description: Type what to look for, comma-separated — anything you can describe in a few words (YOLOE).

pipelines.name: Faces
pipelines.description: Detects faces and names the people you taught it (Learn face).

pipelines.name: Text (OCR)
pipelines.description: Reads text on signs, labels and screens (English + Polish).

pipelines.name: Hand gestures
pipelines.description: Hands (21 landmarks) and 7 gestures: thumb up, thumb down, open palm, fist, pointing up, victory, I-love-you. Unrecognized poses show as 'hand'.

pipelines.name: Body pose
pipelines.description: Skeleton of every person, named by posture and arms (e.g. 'Standing · Arms up'; YOLO11s-pose). Capture saves OpenPose images + JSON (body and hands) for ComfyUI ControlNet.
